summary: Given rather recent advances in AI, it’s relevant in our society has become nearly omnipresent. It is the no surprise that the primary choice of many as the object of a learning interface is said, artificial intelligence, however, whilst ever didactic and simple learning with AI can be it’s still lacks a certain spark of human ingenuity therefore, we the coax present to you our our educational story game. This game is meant for younger audiences yet it’s still seeks to invite those of all ages to learn more about the complex workings of space missions. In this game users will select missions and change parameters to balance tight constraints in an attempt to succeed in landing their spaceship and completing their mission whilst being guided throughout the entire process.
details:
Our project is an educational game built in Unity, in which players go through four stages to design, modify and test possible space missions. It was coded in C# using the Unity game engine.

The first scene displays a selection of missions, each with its own objectives and constraints. The second scene presents the choices players can make, such as fuel, materials and landing gear, to minimize or maximize certain values and ensure their mission succeeds. The third scene simulates the player’s spaceflight. As an optional aid, players can have the game automatically calculate the ideal launch angle and velocity. The fourth scene shows the landing on the planet, where players face the gruelling test of meeting the mission’s landing constraints. Depending on the mission, they may also complete a series of educational tasks on the alien surface.

Throughout the game, players are accompanied by a small, quaint assistant who offers tips, tricks and useful space knowledge along the way. By the end, players will have learned to manage momentum, materials, weight and fuel, among many other skills
